ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONINGLOT DEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the 8th day of May, 2023, by and between 126 PEARL LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 37 West 57th Street, 1orh Floor, New York, NY 10019 (hereinafter, the “Owner"), UDR 10 HANOVER LLC, a Delaware limited liability company having an office c/o UDR, Inc., 1745 Shea Center Drive, Suite 200, Highlands Ranch, CO 80129 (hereinafter called the “Purchaser") ("Developer"), and PATRICIA ARNOLD LAWLESS, having an address at 3318 Hickory Brook Lane, Kingwood, TX 77345 ("Ground Landlord") (Owner, Developer and Ground Landlord are sometimes hereinafter collectively referred to as the“Parties"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of certain land,with the building and improvements thereon, located in the Borough and County of New York, City and State of New York, known as 126 Pearl Street, being Lot 10 in Block 31 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York (the “Tax Map"), and more particularly described on Exhibit "A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as "Owner Land"; said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as the "Owner Building", and Owner Land and Owner Building being hereinafter referred to jointly as the "Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee of a portion of that certain land with the building and improvements thereon located in the Borough and County of New York, City and State of New York, known as 10 Hanover Square, being a portion of Lot 1 in Block 31 on the Tax Map and the lessee of the remainder of Lot 1 in Block 31 on said Tax Map, all as more particularly described on Exhibit "B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said parcel of land and tax lot being referred to herein as " Developer Land"; said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements, enlargements or alterations thereof being hereinafter referred to as "Developer's Building", and Developer Land and Developer Building being hereinafter referred to as " Developer Parcel"); WHEREAS, Ground Landlord is the owner in fee of that certain portion of Developer Parcel of which Developer is lessee (the “Ground Leased Portion') pursuant to that executrix of Estate of Thomas B.Hall, deceased,Patricia Arnold, an infant by Helen H.Arnold, her general guardian and Elizabeth J. Hall and Cradle Realty Corporation, as modified by 1, 1985 between Landlord and The Hanover Square Company, Agreement dated August 1, 2005 Landlord The Hanover LLC and Fourth Amendment to Lease dated December 30, 2008 between Landlord and Ten Hanover LLC (such lease documents, coflectively, the “Lease Documents"); WHEREAS, Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), than is now available for use on the Owner Land pursuant to 1 885767_2/03334-0284
